spadafora.translation: [地名] [意大利] 斯帕达福拉

spade.definition:
n. a playing card in the major suit that has one or more black figures on it
n. a sturdy hand shovel that can be pushed into the earth with the foot
v. dig (up) with a spade
spade.translation:
n. 铲子, 锄, 铲刀, 黑桃
vt. 以锄掘, 把...弄实抹平
vi. 铲

spade beard.translation: 铲形的胡须, 上圆下尖形胡须

spade work.translation: 铲工,铲活,费力的准备工作

spaded.translation:
n. 铁锹, 铲子
vt. 铲；把……弄实抹平
vi. 铲
n. (Spade)人名；(英)斯佩德；(法)斯帕德

spadefish.definition:
n. An American market fish (Chaetodipterus faber) common on
   the southern coasts; -- called also angel fish, moonfish, and porgy.
spadefish.translation: 白鲟, 细鳞白鲳; 铲鱼

spadefoot.definition: n. a burrowing toad of the northern hemisphere with a horny spade-like projection on each hind foot

spadefoots.definition:
plural of spadefoot
n. a burrowing toad of the northern hemisphere with a horny spade-like projection on each hind foot
spadefoots.translation: (spadefoot 的复数) n.[动]锄足蟾(亦作spadefoot toad)

spadeful.definition: n the quantity a shovel can hold

spadefuls.translation: n. 满满一铲子；一满铲

spader.definition:
n. One who, or that which, spades; specifically, a digging
   machine.

spades.definition:
n a playing card in the major suit that has one or more black figures on it
n a sturdy hand shovel that can be pushed into the earth with the foot
n (ethnic slur) extremely offensive name for a Black person
v dig (up) with a spade

spadework.definition: n. dull or routine preliminary work preparing for an undertaking
spadework.translation: n. 挖掘工作, 基础工作, 基本研究

spadic.translation: [医] 古柯叶(南美洲的土名)

spadiceous.definition:
a. Of a bright clear brown or chestnut color.
a. Bearing flowers on a spadix; of the nature of a spadix.
spadiceous.translation: a. 浅褐色的, 栗色的

spadices.definition: n the fleshy axis of a spike often surrounded by a spathe

spadicose.translation: a. [植]肉穗花序的,生肉穗花序的,似肉穗花序的

spadille.definition: n. The ace of spades in omber and quadrille.

spadish.translation: a. 直率的,不转弯抹角的,生硬的

spadix.definition: n. the fleshy axis of a spike often surrounded by a spathe
spadix.translation:
n. 肉穗花序
[医] 佛焰花序, 肉穗花序

spado.definition:
n. Same as Spade, 2.
n. An impotent person.
spado.translation:
n. 无生育能力的人
[法] 无生育能力的人, 无性能力的人, 阉者

spadones.translation: n. 无生育能力的人( spado的名词复数 )

spadroon.definition:
n. A sword, especially a broadsword, formerly used both to
   cut and thrust.

spads.translation: (spad 的复数) 矿山井下测量用钉
